# Iris Flower Analysis

This report uses the built-in `iris` dataset to demonstrate Rho's
chunk panel, render capabilities, and data viewer integration.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

## Data Overview

```{r overview}
data(iris)
str(iris)
summary(iris)
```

## Species Counts

```{r species-counts}
table(iris$Species)
```

## Sepal Dimensions by Species

```{r sepal-boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
boxplot(Sepal.Length ~ Species, data = iris,
        main = "Sepal Length by Species",
        xlab = "Species", ylab = "Sepal Length (cm)",
        col = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A"))
```

## Petal Dimensions by Species

```{r petal-boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=5}
boxplot(Petal.Length ~ Species, data = iris,
        main = "Petal Length by Species",
        xlab = "Species", ylab = "Petal Length (cm)",
        col = c("#E41A1C", "#377EB8", "#4DAF4A"))
```

## Linear Model

```{r model}
model <- lm(Petal.Length ~ Sepal.Length + Sepal.Width, data = iris)
summary(model)
```
